description: Na₅AgGe₂Se₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent GeSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent GeSe₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 9°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.02-3.24 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with two NaSe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one GeSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with four NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent GeSe₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-37°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.07-3.20 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.17 Å. Ag is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Se atoms. There are two shorter (2.70 Å) and two longer (2.79 Å) Ag-Se bond lengths. Ge is bonded to four Se atoms to form GeSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NaSe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one GeSe₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-66°. There are three shorter (2.37 Å) and one longer (2.44 Å) Ge-Se bond length. There are four inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to three Na, one Ag, and one Ge atom to form distorted SeNa₃AgGe trigonal bipyramids that share corners with seven SeNa₅Ge octahedra, corners with two equivalent SeNa₃AgGe trigonal bipyramids, and edges with four SeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-77°. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ge atoms. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to four Na, one Ag, and one Ge atom to form SeNa₄AgGe octahedra that share corners with three SeNa₅Ge octahedra, corners with two equivalent SeNa₃AgGe trigonal bipyramids, edges with five SeNa₅Ge octahedra, and edges with three equivalent SeNa₃AgGe trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-70°. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Ge atom to form SeNa₅Ge octahedra that share corners with two SeNa₅Ge octahedra, corners with five equivalent SeNa₃AgGe trigonal bipyramids, edges with six SeNa₅Ge octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SeNa₃AgGe trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-12°.
